files.description: The EHI export documentation — a single-page PDF describing the export as a ZIP of C-CDA documents per encounter. This is the primary (b)(10) artifact. Extremely minimal: 6 sentences, no data dictionary, no schema, no instructions.

58-page FHIR API documentation for the (g)(10) Standardized API — covers Smart on FHIR OAuth2 auth, patient-level FHIR resource access (US Core resources), patient/encounter search, and terms of use. This is NOT the (b)(10) EHI export documentation but is included for completeness as it was linked alongside the EHI export doc.

FHIR Bundle containing an Endpoint resource (pointing to the FHIR server at qafhir.medonehp.com:9443) and an Organization resource. Infrastructure metadata for the FHIR API, not directly related to the (b)(10) export.

Full-page screenshot of the MedOne certifications/mandatory disclosures page showing certification details, capabilities list, and footer with links to the EHI Export PDF, FHIR URLs, and FHIR API Specifications.
